title: Creating Movement Classes

children:
Movement classes are associated with both locations and items/item class. 
 At the location level, the movement class identifies what products should 
 be stored in a location. For example, a location classified as a movement 
 class A location should only store those UMs with the same movement class 
 (A). At the item/item class level, the movement class is identified per 
 UM (unit of measure). This allows you to identify how frequently a UM 
 for the item/item class is requested. You can use this information to 
 determine which UMs to store, based on how quickly they can be moved. Note that if you associate movement classes with locations, you should also associate 
 item/item class UMs with these movement classes.

Provide an identifier 
 and description for each movement class. Common identifiers include 
 using letters of the alphabet to represent each movement class, or such 
 names as   Fast Movers,   Medium 
 Movers, and   Slow Movers.

Press OK. 
 The system will save your record.
